title: Visiting Professor of Law and John Harvey Gregory Lecturer on World Organization
bio: Anne Orford is Melbourne Laureate Professor and Michael D Kirby Chair of International Law at Melbourne Law School. She researches and teaches in the areas of international law, international dispute settlement, international economic law, climate change, and the history and theory of international law.
